synopsis: Exhaustive field coverage of more than 7,000 testing strata is infeasible, so the corpus treats stratified sampling combined with simulation as unavoidable [f132]. Stratified sampling forces coverage across weather, site, machine and scenario strata, preventing easy, common conditions from dominating testing [f639]. The strata must represent the real domain; forced coverage alone does not satisfy that requirement [f640, f639]. The supplied facts do not specify how to establish representativeness or allocate tests among strata [f640, f639].

relations.note: Explains how stratified sampling broadens coverage when exhaustive field testing is infeasible.
Reliance on stratified sampling requires strata representative of the real domain.
Adds representativeness as a requirement beyond forcing coverage across named dimensions.
